CORRECTED 2026-08-24: initial guess assumed role=dialog like the Add Tracking dialog, but screenshot evidence proved the modal renders and is visible while getByRole("dialog").filter({hasText:"Confirmation"}) found nothing — this modal is not exposed with role=dialog. Switched to matching the literal "Confirmation" heading text; Accept/Reject buttons are now matched globally by role+text instead of scoped to this root, since only one such modal is ever open at a time.

Verified live 2026-08-24: clicking Approve Selected inside Show Details opens a second, separate modal titled "Confirmation" with text "Approve the selected assets?" and two buttons: Reject (dismiss/cancel the confirmation) and Accept (confirm and actually apply the action). Screenshot-confirmed after a failed run where the click alone never changed the review-hint pending count because this modal was never accepted.

Verified live 2026-08-24: after accepting the Complete confirmation, a .p-blockui-document[aria-busy=true] overlay plus a .loader element both stay visible and intercept pointer events well past 20s (Tagging Complete triggers label printing; this demo environment has no printer configured, so the blocking wait can run long).
